verdict.rationale: Dropbox documents built-in AI through Dash: search with AI answers, file summarization, document review, and AI-assisted organization. It also markets upcoming AI drafting and summarization inside Dropbox. This is mostly Q&A and summarization rather than handing off multi-step tasks, and the homepage wording ('AI is coming') suggests some of it is still rolling out. Missing for 10: evidence of agentic delegation of multi-step tasks, a clear statement that the assistant is generally available inside core Dropbox rather than only in Dash, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
